newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Turnover rises on Bahrain bourse, index up.
newsitem.headline: Turnover rises on Bahrain bourse, index up.

text.p: Shares on the Bahrain stock exchange edged higher in the week to Thursday, in sharply stronger volume trade focused on the banking sector.
The exchange said the index rose 10.37 points to 1,624.37 points from 1,614.00 points the previous week.
More than 13.4 million shares worth 2.9 million dinars ($7.7 million) were traded in the week, up from around eight million shares worth 1.6 million dinars a week earlier.
Shares of 24 of the 39 firms listed in the exchange changed hands in 291 transactions.

For the second week running, Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with more than 7.5 million shares worth 910,544 dinars changing hands. The bank's shares closed on Thursday nine fils up at 127 fils each.
Investcorp followed, with 1.37 million shares worth 961,710 dinars traded. Its shares ended the week seven U.S. cents up at $1.87 each.
